cardRanks.description: Card ranks (SPEC 13.4o): card-school track levels queue rank-ups, drafted cards arrive ranked, and rank scales the card. Absent or false keeps cards unranked.

rankUpNeedsFullUpgrades.description: With card ranks on, a card ranks up only once every upgrade slot it has is used (owner, 2026-11-23). Absent or true is on; false lets any card rank up.

upgradeMode.description: How a card upgrades. rolled: the authored block first, then rolled steps and rank-up bonus picks. authored: one upgrade, the card's own upgrade block; nothing is rolled. Absent is rolled.
